title: Rule Manifest V1 (ONE RULE)
description: Exactly one rule changes per episode. This document is the experiment's independent variable, declared BEFORE the simulation runs so the result cannot be chosen after seeing it.

statement.description: The rule in the Director's own words, e.g. 'Close the bridge.' Presentation may quote this verbatim; it is never used as semantic input.

change.description: The machine-actionable change. Exactly one of the change kinds must be present - this is what makes it ONE rule.

close_edges.description: Close edges to specific vehicle classes. RED TEAM (Phase 1): a closure that does not name its modes severs pedestrian routes too, and SUMO then aborts the run with 'Disconnected walk'. A closure MUST therefore declare what it closes. Measured on the Phase 1 grid: closing B1C1/C1B1 outright aborted the simulation; scoping it to disallow=passenger ran correctly.

disallow.description: SUMO vehicle classes barred from the edge, e.g. ['passenger']. Omitting 'pedestrian' keeps the footway usable, which is both physically truthful for a road closure and required for the run to survive.

applies_at_sim_second.description: The rule takes effect at this simulation second and the whole causal chain at that instant already sees it. Directly inherits the old engine's RuleSystem-first correction (DNA-05).

permanent.description: If true, the resulting world change is written into world_state.network.closed_edges and survives any later reversal of this rule.

baseline_required.description: A rule episode MUST run an identical-seed baseline without the change. Consequences are only ever claimed as the difference between two real runs.

prediction.description: Declared before the run. Enables honest prediction error for the viewer: what we expected, versus what the world actually did.
